T: Prohibition Chicago. Bring your own fork.
D: Eliot Ness and a hand-picked team take on Al Capone in Prohibition Chicago.
P: Serve Ness his drink when he meets Malone after the failed raid.
S: crisp risotto balls with mozzarella centres and tomato sauce, before the Union Station steps
Crisp fried risotto balls with a melting mozzarella middle, served with warm tomato sauce. Cook 300g arborio rice in 1L stock to a firm risotto, stir in 50g parmesan and cool completely.
salami, mortadella, prosciutto, artichokes and bocconcini, laid out for the baseball bat banquet
Platter of folded salami, mortadella and prosciutto with marinated artichokes, roast peppers, bocconcini and good bread, laid out banquet style down the middle of the table.
Chicago's own pickled peppers piled on toast
Chop hot giardiniera (pickled peppers, celery, carrot and cauliflower in oil) finely, pile onto toasted baguette rounds over a smear of ricotta.
M: Roast seasoned topside to rare, chill and shave thin. Warm in a jus of beef stock, garlic, oregano and black pepper. Pile into rolls, dip the whole sandwich, hot giardiniera on top.
Buttery cornmeal dough pressed up a deep tin. Mozzarella slices first, then a layer of raw Italian sausage, then chunky crushed tomato with oregano and parmesan. Bake at 220C for 35 minutes.
W: little ricotta and lemon doughnuts in icing sugar, for the Mountie raid at the border

Little fried ricotta doughnuts tossed in icing sugar, light and soft in the middle. Mix 250g ricotta, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon, then fold in 150g self-raising flour.
K: rye, sugar and bitters on a big cube, orange twist, Ness finally has a drink
Stir 60ml rye, 10ml sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds, strain over a big cube, orange twist.

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in 40ml of the hot water to make syrup.
Steep the tea in the rest of the hot water for 4 minutes, strain and chill until cold.
For each drink, stir 60ml tea, a little syrup, a drop of vanilla and a squeezed strip of orange zest over ice for 30 seconds and strain over a large cube.
Twist a fresh strip of orange peel over the top.

edition.cue: Pour the drinks when Ness first meets Malone walking his beat.

s.note: crisp risotto balls with mozzarella centres and tomato sauce, before the Union Station steps
s.how: Cook 300g arborio rice in 1L stock to a firm risotto, stir in 50g parmesan and cool completely. Roll into 16 balls around cubes of 150g mozzarella, roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with 400g warm passata.

s.note: salami, mortadella, prosciutto, artichokes and bocconcini, laid out for the baseball bat banquet
s.how: Fold 100g salami, 100g mortadella and 80g prosciutto onto a long board. Add 200g marinated artichokes, 1 jar roast peppers torn into strips and 200g bocconcini dressed with olive oil, salt and pepper. Slice 1 Italian loaf and serve alongside so everyone builds their own.

m.how: Rub a 1kg beef topside with salt, pepper and oregano and roast at 200C to 52C inside, about 35 minutes. Chill, then shave thin. Simmer 750ml beef stock with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano and plenty of black pepper. Warm the beef in the jus, pile into 4 long rolls, dip the whole sandwich, and top with 200g hot giardiniera.

w.note: little ricotta and lemon doughnuts in icing sugar, for the Mountie raid at the border
w.how: Mix 250g ricotta, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon, then fold in 150g self-raising flour. Drop teaspoons into oil at 175C and fry 3 minutes until puffed and golden. Drain and toss in 60g icing sugar.

d.note: rye, sugar and bitters on a big cube, orange twist, Ness finally has a drink
d.how: Make sugar syrup by dissolving 40g caster sugar in 40ml hot water. For each drink, stir 60ml rye whiskey, 10ml syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds and strain over one big cube. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top. Makes four with 240ml rye.
